sar.narrative: Customer C05766, holder of card C05766-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-12-03 13:00 and 2016-12-03 13:30, 4 transaction(s) totalling $1,908.26 were made on the card online from device profile 'SM-G930R7 | Android 7.0 | chrome 63.0 for android | 1920x1080': $469.75 (3509629, 2016-12-03 13:00), $479.49 (3509649, 2016-12-03 13:07), $471.57 (3509692, 2016-12-03 13:24), $487.45 (3509706, 2016-12-03 13:30). Every amount sat just below $500 and the purchases were placed minutes apart, a pattern consistent with deliberately staying under an authorisation threshold. The activity is suspicious because: Case-memory model score 0.414; 4 online purchases within 30 minutes, each between $400 and $500 ($469.75, $479.49, $471.57, $487.45; total $1,908.26). It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-3748, CC-3841, CC-3907. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placing linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retains the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.
